ui.local: Everything runs in your browser. Nothing is sent to a server.
ui.dropFile: Drop a file here or click to choose one

index.title: Dev tools
index.subtitle: The small tools I reach for while coding: format, convert, decode, generate.

json.title: JSON formatter
json.description: Format, minify and validate JSON, with the line of the error.
json.keywords: format beautify prettify minify validate lint

yaml.title: YAML ↔ JSON converter
yaml.description: Convert YAML to JSON and back.

json-to-ts.title: JSON to TypeScript types
json-to-ts.description: Generate TypeScript interfaces from a JSON response.

sql.title: SQL formatter
sql.description: Indent a SQL query: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite…
sql.keywords: postgres postgresql mysql sqlite query format

markdown.title: Markdown preview
markdown.description: Write Markdown and see it rendered live, tables and task lists included.

diff.title: Text diff
diff.description: Compare two texts by line, word or character.

regex.title: Regex tester
regex.description: Test a regular expression: highlighted matches, groups, replacement.

base64.title: Base64 encoder / decoder
base64.description: Encode and decode text or a file as Base64.
base64.keywords: encode decode b64 file data url

jwt.title: JWT decoder
jwt.description: Read a JWT's header and payload, with its expiry in plain words.

hash.title: Hash generator (MD5, SHA)
hash.description: MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512, SHA3 and CRC32 of a text or a file.
hash.keywords: md5 sha sha1 sha256 sha512 checksum fingerprint crc

base-converter.title: Hex / binary / ASCII converter
base-converter.description: Convert between decimal, hex, binary and octal, and text to bytes.
base-converter.keywords: hex hexadecimal binary decimal octal ascii bytes endian int32

unix-time.title: Unix timestamp converter
unix-time.description: Convert a Unix timestamp to a date and back.

discord-timestamp.title: Discord timestamp generator
discord-timestamp.description: Generate Discord <t:…> tags, shown in each reader's own time zone.

cron.title: Cron expression explainer
cron.description: Turn a cron expression into a sentence and see its next runs.

uuid.title: UUID and password generator
uuid.description: Generate v4 or v7 UUIDs and strong passwords.

qrcode.title: QR code generator
qrcode.description: Make a QR code from text or a link and download it as PNG or SVG.

jsonToTs.needObject: Needs a JSON object or array

jwt.noVerify: The signature is not verified: the tool reads the token without the key. The token is not saved.

discord.hint: Discord shows each tag in the time zone and language of whoever reads the message.

cron.timezone: Computed in your time zone ({{zone}}). On a server, cron follows the server's time zone.

uuid.noAmbiguous: Exclude look-alike characters (I, l, 1, O, 0, o)

qr.empty: Type some text or a link to generate the QR code.
qr.tooLong: Text too long for this correction level
